scientific_contract.candidate_selection: scores only; no response effect is available to the ranker
scientific_contract.candidate_chemistry: only explicit FBMN neutral-mass-compatible candidates; unresolved adduct is abstention
scientific_contract.target_selection: two prespecified registered independent IBD-versus-control study relations
scientific_contract.response_evaluation: IBD200 effects are estimated in held-out participant folds; public effects are fixed
scientific_contract.candidate_response_gate: Plate3 BH q<=0.05 across 662 entities, at least one public target |z|>=1.96, both target studies represented, and all held-out directions concordant
scientific_contract.future_comparison: B and integrated scores must preserve the exact query_ptr/query_ids/candidate_ids axis

claim_boundary: Direction concordance is a descriptive response-support endpoint, not identity truth.
The target studies differ in age and IBD subtype; discordance is not automatically an algorithm error.
Strict library support is not MSI level-1 identity, and unresolved query predictions are not metabolite identifications.
Unregistered public studies are neither positives nor negatives and are excluded from the primary response-support summary.
Development unresolved-response candidates are post-hoc leads and require orthogonal identity and prospective biological confirmation.
Queries without an explicit neutral-mass-compatible candidate are strict chemistry abstentions, not negative results.
